SCIENCE

WHAT IS A PEPTIDE?
WHY DO IMPURITIES MATTER?

Peptides are short chains of amino acids — the same building blocks that make up proteins. During synthesis and purification, small unwanted variants can form.

TECHNICAL STANDARDS & SUPPORT
IMPURITY & REFERENCE STANDARDS
  • Isomers (D&L)
  • Deletion (missing amino acids)
  • Endo (additional amino acids)
  • Truncation (shortened peptide)
  • Oxidation (Trp, Met, etc.)
  • Cyclic (disulfide bridges, cyclic His)
  • Dimers (parallel, antiparallel, head-to-tail)
  • C-terminal acid / amine
  • Salt forms (acetate, TFA, sodium, phosphate)
  • Free base

Availability varies by peptide — enquire for the current matrix.

PORTFOLIO SUPPORT
  • APIs — R&D scale & tech transfer
  • Sidechains — Semaglutide & Liraglutide
  • Speciality building blocks — D-isomer, protected lysine, Trp analogs, oxidised amino acids
  • Characterization — NMR, IR, sequencing, chiral analysis
  • Regulatory filings consulting — across the portfolio

ABOUT

ABOUT PEPCHEM.

FOUNDED 2024 · HYDERABAD, INDIA · PHARMA / BIOTECH / ACADEMIA

SCIENCE WITH PURPOSE.

2024

Pepchem Pharmalabs is a peptide technology company founded in 2024 — with decades of expertise in peptide-based drug discovery, peptidomimetics and generic peptide development, built to serve diverse peptide needs across pharma, biotech and academia.

01 OUR STORY

Founded in 2024 by two chemists — one Indian and one Danish — and headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

02 OUR EXPERTISE

Peptide-based drug discovery, peptidomimetics and generic peptide development.

03 WHO WE SERVE

Pharma, biotech and academia — from building blocks to breakthroughs.
